blind.description: An ornate Baroque or Rococo-style demilune console table. It features a semicircular white marble top with subtle veining supported by an ornate gilded wooden frame. The apron is decorated with carved acanthus scrolls and floral motifs with red and green painted accents. It has four legs—ornate scrolled cabriole legs in front and simpler straight legs in the rear—connected near the base by a curved stretcher centered on a carved decorative urn finial. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no floating or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A semicircular/half-oval white marble tabletop with a flat straight back edge and rounded front, displaying natural grey veining, with the tops of the leg capitals barely protruding at the back corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
